verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs say merchants can 'offer your customers all their preferred payment methods with a single integration' and accept 'cards, wallets, and local payment methods' online, backed by a /paymentMethods endpoint. A hands-on community report confirms local bank methods like iDEAL and Sofort through one integration, and Google Pay processing is documented, though only in the agentic-commerce flow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Apple Pay support, explicit evidence of BNPL methods, and standard-checkout documentation for Google Pay.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Offer your customers all their preferred payment methods with a single integration.
